rules.summary: Nevada's basic minimum wage is $12.00 an hour (DOL table, Nov. 2026).

citation.title: US DOL WHD — State Minimum Wage Laws (updated Nov. 5, 2026)

rules.summary: Nevada requires 1.5x pay after 40 hours in a workweek.

citation.title: US DOL WHD — State Minimum Wage Laws (updated Nov. 5, 2026)
citation.excerpt: Premium Pay After Designated Hours: Weekly - 40

rules.summary: Nevada requires 1.5x after 8 hours in a day for employees earning less than 1.5x the state minimum wage.

citation.title: US DOL WHD — State Minimum Wage Laws (updated Nov. 5, 2026)
citation.excerpt: Employees earning less than 1.5 times the state minimum wage are entitled to premium pay for hours worked in excess of 8 in a single day

rules.summary: Nevada requires a 30-minute meal period for work over 8 hours.

citation.title: US DOL WHD — State meal-period requirements (rev. Jan. 1, 2023)
citation.excerpt: ½ hour, if work is for 8 continuous hours

rules.summary: Nevada requires a paid 10-minute rest period per 4 hours worked.

citation.title: US DOL WHD — State paid rest-period requirements (rev. Jan. 1, 2023)
citation.excerpt: Paid 10-minute rest period for each 4 hours worked or major fraction thereof
